intro: It's All Fun and Games Until... is a quest concerning a deeply troubling discovery brought before Thundris. Recognizing the unmistakable mark of an ancient evil, Thundris arranges for the relic to be sent immediately to Darnassus for further study.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.
They will lose the eye they gained.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look troubled. I am listening.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This bears the mark of an ancient evil, adventurer. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study.
